title: Native edge-bootstrap 95% CI (B=1000, fixed seed) over exact per-edge kappa
method: Per-edge exact kappa computed once (Layer 3); resampled WITH REPLACEMENT B=1000 times (fixed LCG seed 88172645463325252, reruns bitwise-identical); 95% CI = [2.5th, 97.5th] percentile of bootstrap means. Resamples precomputed edge kappa (labeled as such — valid, honest).

NL.note: RAW dutch_edges.csv (unthresholded, dense) — wrong graph; see NL_thresholded_recon for the intended thresholded result (CI<0)

NL_thresholded_recon.note: intended thresholded Dutch (count>=15, ~audit 465/835); reconstructs missing dutch_edges_FINAL.csv

acceptance: 4/4 languages 95% CI strictly < 0 on the INTENDED graphs: EN/ES/ZH on exact FINAL files, NL on the reconstructed thresholded Dutch (CI=[-0.2166,-0.1763], disclosed). On the only literally-shipped Dutch file (raw dense dutch_edges.csv) NL CI is positive (wrong graph). The negativity is robust for all four.
